tagline.en_US: Render PlantUML diagrams through a browser interface or HTTP API using the official Jetty image.

description.en_US: PlantUML Server is a web application designed to generate UML diagrams on the fly. It provides a browser interface to edit PlantUML source text and view the rendered diagram dynamically. It allows users to quickly draft, visualize, and share diagrams without needing local command-line tools.
